title: Backtracking
definition: An algorithmic technique for solving constraint satisfaction problems incrementally. If a partial solution violates constraints, the algorithm 'backtracks' (undoes the choice) and tries another path.
simpleExplanation: Solving a maze. You walk down a path until you hit a dead end, then walk backward to the last intersection and try a different path.

**Intermediate 1:** Solve a common traversal/searching problem using Backtracking.
**Intermediate 2:** Handle edge cases like empty inputs or circular references in Backtracking.
